messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

Each unit is the title of a song by the Beatles. Which one was first released on the album Rubber Soul?

Units:
- Can't Buy Me Love
- Hey Bulldog
- You Like Me Too Much
- Don't Bother Me
- Drive My Car
- Misery
- I Want to Tell You
- Everybody's Trying to Be My Baby
